_about: Only title, goal, criteria and writes are required. type defaults to improvement; verify is test, tool, review or manual; permission is add, edit or remove; links is a list of {label, target} with a path relative to the card folder; the gate is an argv. Create the card with: node core/scripts/card-new.mjs <projectDir> --from-form <this file> --cycle <name>.
title: Show the total on the cart page
goal: The cart page shows the order total, so a shopper sees what they will pay before they check out.

criteria.text: the cart page shows the sum of the item prices
an empty cart shows no total
the new code reads as one small function

must_nots: change how an item price is rounded
interface: none: cart.mjs keeps its exported functions; the page text gains one line.
